column1: # vowel_stem: the stem used before vowel-initial suffixes ("-" = same as lemma).
#   This one mechanism encodes final voicing (kitap/kitab), vowel ellipsis
# harmony_vowel: vowel-harmony override for non-harmonizing loans ("-" = none).
#   The override stands in for the (front) quality of the root-final consonant
#   cluster, e.g. saat -> saati, alkol -> alkolü.
